notes: Cross-verified across three official LG sources: lg.com Global, lg.com Australia, and solutions.lg.com (US) — all agree on: 3x HDMI in (HDMI1/2 HDCP2.2/1.4, HDMI3 HDCP1.4), 1x HDMI out, 1x DisplayPort in (HDCP2.2/1.3), 1x DVI-D in (HDCP1.4), Audio in/out, RS232C in/out, RJ45 LAN x1, IR in, USB 2.0 Type-A x1. A third-party reseller (ProVantage) listed "HDMI (2)" which appears to be an abbreviated/incorrect count contradicted by all three LG-official pages; disregarded in favor of the consistent 3x HDMI figure. HDMI version not explicitly stated by LG as "2.0"; grade inferred as hdmi-2.0 for HDMI1/2 (HDCP2.2 pairing implies HDMI2.0 per LG's typical spec pattern on this display class) and hdmi-1.4 for HDMI3 (HDCP1.4-only). This inference is not from an explicit LG "HDMI 2.0" statement, so treat those grades as medium-confidence. DisplayPort: LG states only the HDCP version pairing (2.2/1.3), not the DP link-rate version; dp-1.2 assigned as nearest available grade in the requested enum (which does not include a 1.3 option) — treat as a low-confidence inferred grade. RS-232C ports are physically 3.5mm 4-pin phone jacks (not DE-9 serial), mapped to trs-3.5 as the closest connector-list match — these are control-signal jacks, not analog audio. AC inlet type (IEC C13/14 vs other) not explicitly confirmed in any fetched source; inferred from LG's standard practice for built-in-PSU large-format commercial signage of this class — treat as an assumption, not confirmed. Not rack-mountable (98" freestanding/wall-mount signage panel, VESA 800x400 mount); rackUnits omitted accordingly. Weight 66 kg head-only / 99 kg packed; dimensions 2191.8 x 1246.8 x 86.1 mm (W x H x D).
